title: Hitting-time bound from a short walk
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$, and suppose $D\le 100|V|$. If there is a walk from $u$ to $v$ of length at most $k$, then for every natural number $N$ the cumulative miss probability for hitting $v$ from $u$ through step $N-1$ is at most $100k|V|^2$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph of positive degree $D$
The walk has length at most $k$
